CustomField.description: Formula field that gets the value from Opportunity Name and/or Topic Name.
CustomField.formula: IF(NOT(ISBLANK(dwp_kitv__opportunity_id__c )), IF(NOT(ISBLANK(dwp_kitv__topic_desc__c)), dwp_kitv__opportunity_id__r.Name + ' · ' + dwp_kitv__topic_desc__c, dwp_kitv__opportunity_id__r.Name), IF(NOT(ISBLANK(dwp_kitv__topic_desc__c)), dwp_kitv__topic_desc__c, ''))
CustomField.label: Summary Topic
